dancing.notes: A classic rock band at bars and beach clubs. Some songs are danceable, but we found no direct sign of a dance floor.

description: A Long Island classic rock band since 2003 with male and female vocals, covering artists like Fleetwood Mac, CCR and the Allman Brothers.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Ira's List 'Lily's Babylon' matches the band's listing for Lily Flanagan's, Babylon. Dancing rating is a guess from genre and venue.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Current website, Facebook, genres and description are all still correct (no new description needed). Booking is by email (TLM@legendarymurphys.com), per the contact page. They also play as a duo (Sandy & Tom Murphy, acoustic rock). The only band photo on the site is a five-photo collage with first-name labels; no single group photo or logo found. No Instagram found.

photos.alt: Collage of the five Legendary Murphys members playing guitar, keyboards and drums, each labeled with a first name
